$comment: Practice recording plan (2026-11-06, user choice: record a practice session for AI clipping). Config data/outputs/presets/practice-record.json: the live plan's H 1920x1080@60 17 Mbps and V 1080x1920 7.5 Mbps rungs, each recorded to a local .mkv (crash-safe). No stream target, so it runs without --live. The clipper uses the H file; V checks the vertical layout. Run: npm run alpha -- --allow-devices --outputs data/outputs/alpha-practice.json, then Record on the control page.
